title: test: PKCS#11 negative-path state machine — pre-init, double-op, invalid args
description:
pkcs11test found that wolfP11 has weak negative-path coverage in the PKCS#11 state machine. These tests belong in wolfP11's own suite so they run in CI without pkcs11test as a dependency.

Write tests in test/wp11_test_pkcs11.c covering:

Pre-init checks (verify wolfP11-b57 fix):
- Call every C_* function before C_Initialize; verify each returns CKR_CRYPTOKI_NOT_INITIALIZED, not CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED
- Specifically: C_EncryptInit, C_GetSlotList, C_GetTokenInfo, C_OpenSession, C_Sign, C_SeedRandom, C_GenerateRandom, C_FindObjectsInit

Argument validation (verify wolfP11-9iz fix):
- C_Initialize with init_args.pReserved != NULL → CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD
- C_Finalize with pReserved != NULL → CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD
- C_GenerateKeyPair with public_attrs=NULL → CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD
- C_GenerateKey with invalid session 99999 → CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID
- C_SeedRandom with pSeed=NULL → CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD

RNG codes (verify wolfP11-z7e fix):
- C_SeedRandom with invalid session → CKR_SESSION_HANDLE_INVALID
- C_SeedRandom if seeding not supported → CKR_RANDOM_SEED_NOT_SUPPORTED or CKR_RANDOM_NO_RNG (spec allows both)
- C_GenerateRandom with pRandomData=NULL → CKR_ARGUMENTS_BAD

Session state machine:
- C_Login(CKU_SO) with open RO session → CKR_SESSION_READ_ONLY_EXISTS (verify wolfP11-eg0 fix)
- C_Login twice → CKR_USER_ALREADY_LOGGED_IN
- C_Sign before C_SignInit → CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED
- C_Sign after failed C_SignInit → CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED (verify wolfP11-13f fix)
- C_FindObjects before C_FindObjectsInit → CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED
- C_FindObjectsFinal before C_FindObjectsInit → CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED
- C_Encrypt/C_Decrypt before C_EncryptInit/C_DecryptInit → CKR_OPERATION_NOT_INITIALIZED

Cross-slot:
- C_DestroyObject using session from wrong slot → CKR_OBJECT_HANDLE_INVALID (verify wolfP11-w2m fix)

Each test: assert the exact CKR_ code, not just 'non-zero'. Every test is independent (fresh C_Initialize/C_Finalize).
